properties.headline: Rip Current Statement issued November 2 at 3:59AM ChST until November 2 at 4:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 8 to 10 feet in the surf zone
and dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...West and north facing reefs of the Marianas.

* WHEN...For the High Surf Advisory, until 4 PM ChST Monday. For
the High Rip Current Risk, through Monday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated, long-period, northwest swell from
Typhoon In-fa will continue to produce hazardous surf and a high
risk of rip currents along west and north facing reefs through
this afternoon, possibly diminishing below hazardous levels
tonight as swells steadily diminish. Hazardous surf of 8 to 10
feet is expected to diminish below hazardous levels, becoming 6
to 8 feet tonight. However, if the long-period swell energy
remains elevated longer than expected, then the High Surf
Advisory and High Rip Current Risk Statement may be extended
once more.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. Inexperienced swimmers
should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.
If caught in a rip current, relax and float. Don't swim against
the current. If able, swim in a direction following the shoreline.
If unable to escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
